subject: Close horizon reset and risk tagging
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@averyco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: short MAP update + ask on procurement milestone

Hi Samir —

Quick note after this morning's sync: Procurement told us there will be a 2–3 week review on the data processing addendum, which pushes the previously discussed go-live window out. To keep momentum we propose a slimmed MAP that keeps engineering deliverables steady while shifting procurement and billing milestones.

Attached: MAP_AveryCo_v3.xlsx (condensed milestones) and a 1-page procurement timeline slide. Can you confirm:
- Who in procurement will own the DPA review?
- Is there any legal redline that could accelerate a parallel review?

Suggested next steps (short):
1) Agree on updated close horizon (propose Nov 30 -> Dec 21)
2) Blue-team technical can run integration tests the week of Nov 16 (no dependency on DPA sign-off)
3) We prepare a credit / pilot clause if procurement requires PoC only

If this works, Karthik and Laura will update MAP and circulate for signatures.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.n@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
[Attachment: MAP_AveryCo_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Procurement_timeline_slide.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@averyco.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@averyco.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: short MAP update + ask on procurement milestone

Priya — thanks for the heads up and the concise MAP. A few notes:

- Procurement will own the DPA review (I've looped them) but also our legal has a standing pause for cross-border data items. It could be the main blocker — timeline TBD.
- The technical team can run integration tests Nov 16 as proposed; they just need a staging key.
- On the credit/pilot clause: procurement will likely request a 30-day pilot with limited tokens and a revenue holdback.

I'll confirm procurement point of contact by EOD tomorrow. For now, can we mark the risk "Procurement DPA" as "High" and add a mitigation row with the pilot/credit option?

Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Data Products, AveryCo

Subject: Re: Proposal: short MAP update + ask on procurement milestone

Thanks Samir — noted. Priya: I pulled the engineering milestone sheet and added a staging key dependency and a fallback plan to run inference tests using a small synthetic dataset if tokens are limited.

Small ask for MAP update: please add an explicit acceptance criteria row for the PoC (sample queries, latency < 200ms p50 for 512 tokens, functional pass on 10 test cases). If procurement insists on holdback, we can call out a billing milestone tied to sign-off rather than DPA signature.

I'll prepare a short "MAP diff" (one-slide) so execs can see what changes.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: short MAP update + ask on procurement milestone

Samir — appreciate the quick reply. I've updated the attached MAP to add:
- Risk register entry: "Procurement DPA" set to HIGH with mitigation steps (pilot + holdback option).
- Acceptance criteria row for the PoC as Karthik suggested.
- Suggested new close horizon: Dec 21 (from Nov 30).

Jonas: looping you for visibility — if procurement's ask results in a holdback we may need a localized commercial flexibility (short credit or phased billing) to preserve ARR cadence. Can you advise on pre-approved concession bands?

Action items for us:
- Samir: confirm procurement POC (by 11/6 EOD)
- Karthik: prepare the MAP diff slide (by 11/6 close)
- Laura: ready an SOW stub with pilot terms we can share if holdback is requested

Thanks —
Priya
[Attachment: MAP_AveryCo_v3_updated.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@averyco.com>
Cc: Finance <finance@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: short MAP update + ask on procurement milestone

Thanks for the summary, Priya. Quick guidance from commercial: we have an established concession band for pilot/holdback scenarios — up to a single-month credit or a 20% revenue holdback for no more than 60 days without Exec approval. Anything beyond that requires a short-form approval from Sales Ops + Finance.

My recommendation: implement the pilot clause in the MAP as a conditional milestone ("Pilot start on sign of technical stub; billing deferred until DPA or 60 days post-pilot"). Laura, please prepare the short SOW language and share with Samir tomorrow. Karthik, prioritize the MAP_diff slide for the exec summary.

Samir — happy to jump on a 20-minute call Monday if it helps resolve procurement dependencies quickly.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales — North America, Redwood Inference
